verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.usestable.com that returns HTTP 200 and is headed "Stable Documentation." A second llms.txt exists on the marketing site at usestable.com/llms.txt. The docs pages are also served as raw .md files (e.g. getting-started.md, webhooks.md), so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any probed path, and no evidence of llms.txt content depth (e.g. an llms-full.txt or complete page index) or of hands-on agent use.
